thread:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. alert_id=inc-1755552468
eng_julia: seeing huge 5xx spike ~12% on prod, started ~09:32 UTC. stack traces show repeated segfaults in model-runner.
oncall_mike: I'm on it, stepping in as oncall. assigning to eng_julia and sre_anna.
sre_anna: any customer-visible errors? monitoring shows increased latency + 502s returned to clients.
cust_success_lara: flagged by top-20 customer A; they're seeing timeouts in their requests. major impact.
eng_julia: logs: ```
[2026-03-15T09:33:12Z] model-runner[pid=2147]: segfault at 0x0 ip=0x7f... rax=0x0
[2026-03-15T09:33:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2147 (model-runner) total-vm:12G anon-rss:9G
```
infra_raj: that's consistent with OOM kills on several nodes, but also see coredumps with SIGSEGV before OOM. could be corrupted kv-cache causing mem growth.
ops_lead_tom: TL;DR — instances running model vX.1 on gpu-pool-qa are crashing, causing gateway 502s. we need quick mitigation.
eng_julia: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route traffic away from affected model variant to a stable fallback quantized variant (vX.0-q) 2) drain crashing nodes 3) enable extra retries 4) begin trace collection for failing requests.
oncall_mike: agree. start traffic reroute now. I’ll kick the routing change.
incident-bot: Deploy comment: route-change requested by oncall_mike. change_id=chg-8892
eng_julia: command to reroute (internal): ```curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/routes/reroute -d '{"from":"model:vX.1","to":"model:vX.0-q","percent":100}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'```
ops_lead_tom: doing 50% first to smoke-test. ready to roll to 100% if metrics recover.
eng_julia: +1. starting 50%.
incident-bot: Route update applied: 50% traffic -> vX.0-q.
sre_anna: after 50% shift latency down from 1.2s -> 0.9s and 5xx rate down to 6%. still elevated but improving.
cust_success_lara: let me update impacted customer A, tell them we're routing to a fallback model and working on root cause.
oncall_mike: draining nodes now: marking 4 nodes in gpu-pool-west-2 as unschedulable. ```kubectl cordon runner-42; kubectl drain runner-42 --ignore-daemonsets```
infra_raj: collecting coredumps from drained nodes, uploading to s3://redwood-dumps/1755552468/ for offline analysis.
eng_julia: discovered a regression in attention kernel when sequence_len > 2048 with the new allocator. reproducing locally, trying to force a safe path that uses legacy allocator.
ops_lead_tom: can we hotfix to disable the new allocator on prod?
eng_julia: yes, we can ship config toggle: `USE_NEW_ALLOC=0` for the model-runner container. will push a canary to 10% before wider rollout.
oncall_mike: do the canary. keep routing at 50% until canary stable.
incident-bot: Canary started: runner-config-update canary_id=can-771, target=10%
sre_anna: canary logs look clean, no segfaults for ~7m. 5xx rate for canary hosts = 0.4%.
eng_julia: rolling config to all drained nodes after verifying. pushing `USE_NEW_ALLOC=0` to runner image tag vX.1-hotfix.
ops_lead_tom: we should also increase short-term retry window at gateway to hide transient restarts: set retry=3, backoff=200ms.
infra_raj: applying gateway retry policy now.
cust_success_lara: customer A asked about risk of model change affecting outputs — will confirm that vX.0-q is functionally similar for their use case.
eng_julia: note: fallback model is quantized variant — quality check: basic prompt regression tests show similar ROUGE scores but minor differences on few prompts. we should offer customer A the option to pin to a region using Dedicated capacity if they need exact parity.
oncall_mike: metrics after full rollout: incident-bot reports 5xx back to baseline (~0.5%), latency normalized. traces show no further segfaults after allocator toggle.
incident-bot: Incident update: primary mitigation applied, customer-impact = partial (timeouts/502s for ~8m before reroute). status=mitigated.
sre_anna: next steps: 1) postmortem prep 2) root cause: allocator regression in attention kernel under long sequences 3) permanent fix plan: revert allocator refactor or add safety checks + fuzz seq_len tests 4) retro for deploy gating.
eng_julia: opening a hotfix PR now and will include expanded unit tests for seq_len edges. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/model-runner/pulls/582
ops_lead_tom: good. also schedule maintenance window to repro on a staging cluster with same load.
cust_success_lara: I've told the customer timeline and next steps, they're appreciative of the quick reroute.
oncall_mike: thanks team. I'll keep the incident channel open for postmortem notes. handing back to eng rotation. :white_check_mark:
eng_julia: final note: total impacted requests ~12k in 08:33-08:41 UTC, estimated customer A saw 7% failure rate during window. full dump + logs at s3://redwood-dumps/1755552468/ and traces in tracy:trace/1755552468.
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging purposes. If regressions appear, reopen with `incident reopen 1755552468`. :rotating_light:
eng_julia: filing postmortem doc now.
